title: Cross-functional staff bridge — 2026-05-06
content:
Attendees: Aisha (chair), Miguel, Priya, Liam, Zoe, Ravi, + notes from on-call (SRE rota)

Purpose: quick cross-team alignment for this week — surface blockers, coordinate for release gating, and allocate short-term support for Dedicated rollout tests.

1) Quick rundowns (2 min per lead)
- Serving runtime (Miguel): loadgen for quantized variants completed on GPU farm B; early perf numbers look good but tail latencies spike at 99.9th pct under pathological prompt sizes. Investigating KV cache eviction heuristics.
  - Blocker: a flaky kernel dispatch path when sequence_len > 4096 triggers soft OOM on some nodes. Root cause suspected to be mismatch in kernel selection fallback.
  - Next: Miguel to open JIRA-SRV-5178 with reproduction case + attach perf traces by EOD 2026-05-06.

- Platform infra (Priya): autoscaler tuning rolled to canary; observed under-provisioning when pod startup latency > 45s for cold model loads. Proposed short-term mitigation: add pre-warm buffer for model artifacts for Dedicated customers.
  - Decision: approve pre-warm buffer for Dedicated pilot for 2 weeks. Priya to draft rollout playbook and KB.

- Observability (Liam): distributed tracing sampling miscounts were discovered — costs are higher than forecast by ~18% last month. Working on sampling policy changes per-customer and token.
  - Action: Liam to coordinate with Product for quota adjustments and send usage forecast to finance by 2026-05-08.

- Console + Rollouts (Zoe): canary/Perc50 gating UI is in review; rollouts page now surfaces model variant differences and recent eval regressions. Need docs update for product.
  - Blocker: UX uses an internal metric id that doesn't match export pipeline. Zoe to sync with Observability (Liam) and release a compatibility shim.

- Solutions/Customer Eng (Ravi): onboarding a mid-market customer for Private deployment; they require HSM integration and a 3rd-party audit before go-live. POC for HSM done, audit timeline unclear.
  - Risk: this customer is on the Dedicated conversion path; need SRE standby for first week.

2) Deep dive: Dedicated capacity pilot checklist (10 min)
- Summary: Dedicated pilot for three customers starts 2026-05-11. Checklist reviewed. Items outstanding: pre-warm buffer implementation (infra), audit readiness (security/compliance), and SLA alerting thresholds (SRE).
- Owners/ETA:
  - Pre-warm buffer + canary config: Priya / 2026-05-09
  - SLA alerting baseline dashboards: Liam / 2026-05-08
  - Audit kickoff + HSM cust docs: Ravi / 2026-05-10
- Contingency: if pre-warm buffer not ready, fallback to reserved capacity on legacy pool and add 2x margin for first 72 hours. Decision: approved.

3) Open blockers / cross-team handoffs (15 min)
- Kernel dispatch soft OOM (Serving runtime) — Miguel needs an SRE pairing session to collect traces and reproduce at scale.
  - Action: SRE on-call (this week: D. Park) + Miguel pair Tuesday 9:00am PT. Add reproduction to JIRA-SRV-5178.

- Tracing sampling mismatch (Observability) — affects cost reporting and billing.
  - Action: Liam to push a sampling patch to staging; Priya to run cost forecast against last month's data.

- Rollouts UI metric id mismatch (Console) — Zoe needs a compatibility shim.
  - Action: Zoe + Miguel to agree on schema by Friday; devs to gate on integration tests GH-PR-6543.

- HSM + Audit for Private (Customer Eng + Security) — Ravi flagged that audit vendor requires a private build artifact signing workflow.
  - Action: Ravi to create Confluence stub CONF-HSM-AUDIT with timeline + ask list; Security (not present) to respond by 2026-05-09.

4) Standup-style logs (notes captured during the week)
- 2026-05-04 (Mon): Serving runtime performed A/B on quantization profiles; quant 8-bit saved 28% cost but subjective quality regressions on domain prompts.
- 2026-05-05 (Tue): Loadgen found edge case in long-context composition; mitigation: temporarily cap sequence_len in canary at 6k.
- 2026-05-06 (Wed): Infra applied a node image update that caused 5% pod failure rate on warm-starts; rollback applied and incident postmortem draft assigned to Priya.

5) New risks flagged
- Risk: If kernel dispatch bug persists, Dedicated pilot throughput will be reduced by ~30% and risk missing SLAs.
  - Mitigation: apply fallback with increased reserved CPU for those pods and enable aggressive batching to preserve token throughput.

- Risk: Observability cost overrun could force a sampling change that reduces fidelity for A/B evals.
  - Mitigation: export a lightweight eval-only trace lane to keep critical data for regressions.

6) Decisions made during meeting
- Approve pre-warm buffer for Dedicated pilot (see action owners)
- Use legacy pool fallback if pre-warm not ready for pilot start
- SRE pairing on kernel dispatch repro this week

7) Action items (owner — due)
- Miguel — open JIRA-SRV-5178 with perf traces + repro (2026-05-06)
- Priya — rollout playbook + pre-warm canary config (2026-05-09)
- Liam — sampling policy change PR + finance forecast (2026-05-08)
- Zoe — compatibility shim plan and integration tests (GH-PR-6543) (2026-05-07)
- Ravi — CONF-HSM-AUDIT stub + audit timeline (2026-05-09)
- D. Park (SRE) — pair with Miguel to repro (2026-05-12)

8) Misc notes / ad-hoc topics
- A quick ask from Product: need a short blurb for the upcoming customer-facing Dedicated FAQ by 2026-05-08. Zoe to draft; Product to review.
- Reminder: all leads to tag rollout-related PRs with "rollout-2026q2" label so our release pipeline can auto-enforce gates.

9) Parking lot / unresolved questions
- Exact SLA numbers for Dedicated pilot in the event of fallback — follow-up with commercial (Sales) for tolerances.
- Audit vendor quote not yet finalized — Ravi to escalate if no response by 2026-05-09.

Next meeting: cross-team staff bridge Wednesday 2026-05-13 at 10:00am PT. Draft agenda to be circulated by Aisha on 2026-05-11.

Notes-to-self: document feels rough — will convert to polished postmortem checklist after actions settle. Keep this doc as working notes and attach incident links when available.

References / quick links: JIRA-PLAT-4821, JIRA-SRV-5178, GH-PR-6543, CONF-Platform-Staff-Bridge

End of notes.
